desc:
Build your country on an island, then fight other players for the map 🌍

• Grow a small town into a big city: roads, homes, power, water, mines, factories, oil
• Trucks and ships deliver everything you produce. Lose a road or a depot and your factories stop
• Trade, make alliances, sell electricity to your neighbours
• Or go to war: tanks, landing ships, rocket artillery, drones, cruise and ballistic missiles 🚀
• Protect your city with AA guns, SAM sites and missile defence
• Take enemy cities and draw the new border at the peace conference

Play with friends or against bots 🤖 2 to 6 players, 7 maps. A match lasts 1.5–2 hours.

The game is in beta. Expect bugs, and things may change between updates
